- The first watermark-free export came out on B5 paper, each board shrunk into the top-left and
  cut off (the generator's named-paper bug, ad hoc todo on 29 Oct). Re-exported on Original (A1).
  It moves the credits board to page 2, and pages 50–52 are posters; acts start
  4/6/11/19/26/33/43, the book ends on 49 (`ac1f871`).
- `art/*.pdf` is now gitignored.
- F2: share button with the share sheet, else a Copy link / Save page menu; a 1200×630 card per
  page (the page on a blurred crop of itself, no text, so no fonts), and per-page Open Graph
  tags (`b9d7a4d`). Checked in desktop Chrome; WhatsApp/LINE cards need the production domain,
  since previews sit behind Vercel's login.
  Preview: https://riverbanks-microsite-iql4px5gs-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app/p/15
- F2 changed after Yan tried it in desktop Safari: the system sheet came first (no chat apps on a
  Mac) and closing it opened our menu too (Safari's NotAllowedError). Now our menu comes first,
  with the sheet as "More options…" (`c37a4fd`).
- F3 landing (`7cc1d31`): the cropped map with seven glowing markers, Sam's intro verbatim (the
  draft copy is gone), and a dev-only `/?place` for Yan to drag the markers to where each act
  happens. The positions are still the mockup's sketch. The "here" link is plain text until
  there's a target. Preview: https://riverbanks-microsite-rnzbwyo6a-yanthibicos-projects.vercel.app
